text.description: Free text, matched as a substring of fi/en/sv names and brand (min 3 chars per word).
text.title: Text

free_from.description: nutritionalClaim ids that must be present, e.g. FREE_FROM_LACTOSE, FREE_FROM_GLUTEN, VEGAN.
free_from.title: Free From

exclude_allergens.description: Allergen codes (AM, AW...) or groups (milk, gluten, nuts) the product must not CONTAIN.
exclude_allergens.title: Exclude Allergens

category.description: Category code or prefix, e.g. '10400' (milk) or '104'.
category.title: Category

labels.description: packagingMarkedLabel ids that must be present, e.g. GOODS_FROM_FINLAND_BLUE_SWAN.
labels.title: Labels

exclude_terms.description: Drop products whose name contains any of these words (e.g. kahvi, kaakao).
exclude_terms.title: Exclude Terms
